title: Land dev-tooling group: Biome 2.5.12 config migration, CSS specificity fix, vitest 5
description: PR #530 (dependabot dev-tooling group: @biomejs/biome 2.5.11->2.5.12, vitest ^4.1.7->^5.0.0, tsx 4.23.12->4.23.13) fails build-test on Biome twice: biome.json declares $schema 2.5.5 against CLI 2.5.12 (needs npx biome migrate --write), and Biome 2.5.12 newly emits style/noDescendingSpecificity at site/src/styles.css:555, which CI fails on under --error-on-warnings. Fix both on the dependabot branch and take the vitest 5 major in the same PR after a full local verify.
notes: Fix pushed onto the dependabot branch; PR https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/530. Bead stays in_progress until it merges.
